objective: Implement a bounded Zubercal DR20 HATS adapter that preserves raw detections and reports all PS1 candidates without automatically selecting a physical counterpart.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: Zubercal DR20 uses PS1 IDs, MJD(TDB), scaled magerr and distinct flag/info fields; sources without PS1 matches are absent.
One 1.2 arcsec cone for ZTF OID 264114400013085 returned 123 rows and two PS1 IDs; ambiguity is observed.
The source-product contract recommends DR24 HATS as primary discovery and Zubercal as a supplementary calibration stream.

expected_improvement: Provide a bounded remote Zubercal DR20 cone-query adapter
Preserve raw rows and raw magerr units
Report candidate PS1 IDs and match ambiguity

correctness.before: A bounded probe accessed Zubercal directly, but no reusable project adapter existed.
correctness.after: A typed request/result adapter returns raw rows, candidate summaries, row annotations, explicit match state and NOT_SELECTED decision.

coverage.before: The probe report held a single aggregate match state.
coverage.after: Adapter exposes all candidate PS1 IDs, row counts, bands, separations and raw rows.

reproducibility.before: Probe evidence was stored as a workflow artifact.
reproducibility.after: Adapter output includes canonical raw-payload SHA-256 and query provenance.

scientific_validity.reason: No physical counterpart is selected and no DR24/Zubercal photometric parity is claimed.

measurement.trade_off: The adapter preserves ambiguity and source-native data. It does not create a convenient but unverified single-source join.

evidence: Pure unit tests cover no-match, single/multiple PS1 IDs, input bounds and raw-row separation.
A live adapter parity workflow is added for the pinned ambiguous DR20 cone; it has not completed on the final head.

root_causes: Zubercal objectid is a PS1 ID, not a ZTF OID.
The bounded probe returned two PS1 IDs for one ZTF OID within 1.2 arcsec.
unresolved: Which PS1 ID is the correct astrophysical counterpart remains unresolved for the observed source.
The adapter has not been connected to a user-facing crossmatch decision workflow.

findings: Never equate Zubercal PS1 objectid with ZTF OID.
Keep row-level angular separations separate from raw Zubercal records.
Multiple PS1 candidates must produce an explicit ambiguous state and NOT_SELECTED decision.
Keep MJD(TDB), scaled magerr, flag and info separate from DR24 HMJD, magerr and catflags.

open_blockers: Run unit tests and the live adapter parity workflow on the final branch head.
Validate row counts, candidate IDs and raw payload hash against the bounded probe artifact.
Do not integrate candidate PS1 IDs into source grouping or model inference until independent identity validation passes.

knowledge_carried_forward: Zubercal DR20 adapter is supplementary only.
No PS1 candidate is automatically selected.
Raw rows and match annotations are separate.
